payload.friendly_name: Glossary pack and skill round trip
payload.purpose_context: Epic #186 brings all Charter Pack content into the service's domain model. This mission (#192) adds the glossary pack and skill kinds: the service reads each glossary pack and each skill with its prompt body, holds them as domain artifacts and writes them back unchanged in meaning, so the whole-pack round-trip gate turns glossary packs from expected red to green and the pack skills round-trip as descriptor-and-body pairs.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every glossary pack and skill in the pinned Charter Packs is read into the service's domain and written back with its meaning intact.

options: Descriptor only: body listed as unmodelled, follow-up issue
payload.question: Is the skill's Markdown prompt body (body_path) in scope, held on the Skill and written as a pair, through a companion-file seam that #192 builds and #193 extends (recorded in a new ADR-0040)?

payload.final_answer: In scope: the body is a value on the Skill, written as a pair through a text-only companion-file seam #192 builds and #193 extends; recorded in ADR-0040. Intent summary confirmed (closed schemas, glossary gate green, skill corpus evidence on packs/internal, id≠stem kept as authored and raised upstream).
